data.title: Is Bitcoin a Good Investment for Retirement? What Experts Recommend
data.description: Suze Orman, Clark Howard, and Dave Ramsey all have opinions on whether retirees should hold Bitcoin, and they do not fully agree. The answer depends on one factor most retirees overlook when they first consider adding crypto to their portfolio.
data.keywords: Clark Howard, Suze Orman, Dave Ramsey, Bitcoin investment
